```{r}

#Backward selection using p-value cutoff


back_select_pvalue <- function(dat, vars, outcome = "y", alpha_cutoff = 0.05) {
  
  current_vars <- vars
  
  repeat {
    
    if (length(current_vars) == 0) break
    
    form <- as.formula(
      paste(outcome, "~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + "))
    )
    
    fit <- lm(form, data = dat)
    coef_table <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    
    if (nrow(coef_table) <= 1) break
    
    pvals <- coef_table[-1, "Pr(>|t|)", drop = TRUE]
    max_p <- max(pvals, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (max_p > alpha_cutoff) {
      drop_var <- names(which.max(pvals))
      current_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, drop_var)
    } else {
      break
    }
  }
  
  current_vars
}


#Backward selection using actual AIC or BIC


back_select_ic <- function(dat, vars, outcome = "y", criterion = c("AIC", "BIC")) {
  
  criterion <- match.arg(criterion)
  current_vars <- vars
  
  get_ic <- function(fit) {
    if (criterion == "AIC") {
      AIC(fit)
    } else {
      BIC(fit)
    }
  }
  
  repeat {
    
    if (length(current_vars) == 0) break
    
    current_form <- as.formula(
      paste(outcome, "~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + "))
    )
    
    current_fit <- lm(current_form, data = dat)
    current_ic <- get_ic(current_fit)
    
    candidate_results <- purrr::map_dfr(current_vars, function(drop_var) {
      
      candidate_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, drop_var)
      
      if (length(candidate_vars) == 0) {
        candidate_form <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ 1"))
      } else {
        candidate_form <- as.formula(
          paste(outcome, "~", paste(candidate_vars, collapse = " + "))
        )
      }
      
      candidate_fit <- lm(candidate_form, data = dat)
      
      tibble(
        drop_var = drop_var,
        candidate_ic = get_ic(candidate_fit)
      )
    })
    
    best_candidate <- candidate_results %>%
      arrange(candidate_ic) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    if (best_candidate$candidate_ic < current_ic) {
      current_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, best_candidate$drop_var)
    } else {
      break
    }
  }
  
  current_vars
}
```
